text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
- Socialist Party (PS) wins most votes in regional elections in the Azores. Centre-right Social Democratic Party (PSD) retains grip on power in Madeira.
- State oil company Petrogal is benefitting from the rise in the price of refined products as it bought crude cheaply, a company source told the paper.
- The Banco Nacional de Angola (BNA) owes 30.8 billion escudos to Portuguese companies, mainly from the textile and clothing sector.
- Industrial group Sonae plans to launch its new in-store bank Universo Banco Directo in the first quarter of 1997, a source involved with the process told the paper.
- Finance Minister Antonio Sousa Franco has to find a solution to the financial difficulties of Portuguese ship repairer Lisnave by the end of 1996.
- Joao Salgueiro, president of Portugal's biggest state bank Caixa Geral de Depositos (CGD), says Portugal could export financial services.
